title: Perfection and stalk support of the explicit affine Koszul object
statement: Let A be a commutative ring and f:Fin(r)\to A a finite tuple. Choose derived categories for module sheaves on Spec(A) and on each localized open site [def-pc-derived-category]. Form Q by placing the actual Koszul chain complex [def-weil-pbc-koszul-complex] in cochain degrees -q, applying the associated-sheaf functor termwise, and localizing. Then Q is perfect [def-pc-perfect-complex]. For every integer n and every prime x for which some f_i is not in x, the stalk at x of H^n(Q) is zero. No detection or open-unit assertion is made.

proof.text: Use the exterior-power basis of the free module on Fin r, reindexed by ULift (Fin m). The associated-sheaf functor sends this basis isomorphism to the finite free sheaf by tildeFinsupp, and open restriction preserves finite coproducts and the unit sheaf. For q > r the exterior basis index is empty, so the term is zero. The cochain extension has zero positive terms and identifies its term in degree -q with the q-th Koszul term. Thus every open restriction is strictly perfect with bounds -r and 0. At each point choose the top open; mapDerivedCategoryFactors identifies derived restriction with the localization of this explicit restricted complex.

Let U be the union of D(f_i). Apply isZero_restrict_shift_koszul at shift zero and remove the zero shift by shiftFunctorZero. Exact restriction commutes with homology: compose mapDerivedCategoryFactors, homologyFunctorFactors, and mapHomologicalComplexHomologyIso to identify restricted derived homology with restriction of the homology sheaf. It is therefore zero. If f_i is not in x, then x lies in U. Represent each stalk element by a section on V and restrict to V intersect U. The identity of the zero restricted sheaf is zero, so this restricted section is zero, and the original germ is zero. This proves that the homology stalk is subsingleton in every degree, without any new contraction lemma.

theorem affine_koszul_geometric_properties
    (A : Type u) [CommRing A] (r : ℕ) (f : Fin r → A)
    [HasDerivedCategory.{w}
      (SheafOfModules.{u} (moduleRings (Spec (.of A)).toRingedSpace))]
    [∀ V : (Spec (.of A)).Opens, HasDerivedCategory.{w}
      (SheafOfModules.{u} ((moduleRings (Spec (.of A)).toRingedSpace).over V))] :
    let Q := DerivedCategory.Q.obj
      ((@Functor.mapHomologicalComplex ℤ (ModuleCat.{u} A)
        (SheafOfModules.{u} (moduleRings (Spec (.of A)).toRingedSpace))
        _ _ _ _ (tilde.functor (.of A))
        ⟨fun _ _ ↦ tilde.map_zero⟩ (ComplexShape.up ℤ)).obj
        ((ExteriorAlgebra.koszulComplex A r f).extend ComplexShape.embeddingDownNat))
    Scheme.IsPerfect (Spec (.of A)) Q ∧
      ∀ (n : ℤ) (x : PrimeSpectrum A), (∃ i, f i ∉ x.asIdeal) →
        Subsingleton (↑(TopCat.Presheaf.stalk ((DerivedCategory.homologyFunctor
          (SheafOfModules.{u} (moduleRings (Spec (.of A)).toRingedSpace)) n).obj
            Q).val.presheaf x))
